label: Day Master page · manifesto · STEM.manifesto
value: Clarity before comfort · You are the Metal that cuts a clean line.

label: Day Master page · dm_overview · STEM.dm_overview
value: The Blade is Yang Metal, steel given an edge in the forge. Its season is autumn, when the cut divides what stays from what must go. It has a purpose. Against the whetstone, it gives up a little metal to keep that purpose clear. Drawn from its sheath, the blade makes a line that cannot be softened once it is made.

label: Day Master page · band.yourNature_desc · STEM_BAND.yourNature_desc
value: You are what the sword is like when it wakes up as a person. The cut is always ready and mostly used. You put the truth ahead of comfort, yours and everyone's, every day, in every setting. People bring you the questions nobody else will answer straight, then flinch at exactly what they asked for. The edge never rests. That includes the nights, and it includes you.

label: Day Master page · band.self_card.face · STEM_BAND.self_card
value: The edge, never sheathed

label: Day Master page · band.self_card.presence · STEM_BAND.self_card
value: You meet a loose claim with a sharp answer. Even casual talk can leave you holding a line nobody meant to test.

label: Day Master page · gifts[6] (order door, ) · STEM.gifts

value.desc: You can turn pressure into a clear next step. When a plan falls apart, you can cut the problem down to the part that needs attention first.

label: Day Master page · gifts[5] (action door, ) · STEM.gifts

value.desc: You can keep working a piece long enough for each cut to build on the last. Practice leaves skill behind. The next task can begin with something the earlier one made possible.

label: Day Master page · gifts[4] (expression door, ) · STEM.gifts

value.desc: You can put a clean edge on a thought without forcing the words. An explanation gives someone something they can use. What takes shape inside you can pass into ordinary conversation.

label: Day Master page · shadows[1] (body door, ) · STEM.gifts

value.desc: Once you have decided what something is, it stays that way. The person who grew, the plan that improved, the second chance that was earned, they all arrive at a door already shut.

label: Day Master page · shadows[3] (mind door, ) · STEM.gifts

value.desc: You keep sharpening an answer that needs to be tried. Another note makes the plan feel fuller, while the edge stays on the stone and the work waits for a first cut.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · mechanism.base · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.base
value: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any edge is struck from it, and every blade remembers the patience of the rock that made it.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · mechanism.friction_turn · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.catalyst_turn
value: Run heavy, the shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Dig out and cut something real.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · carry.friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.carry

value.clause: The shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine.
value.remedy: Dig out and cut something real.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · function.definition_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst
value: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is preparation that keeps asking for more. Your notes get longer and your reading list fills up while the decision waits. You have plenty to draw from. Taking in another explanation becomes easier than putting your own work to the test.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · ledger[0] (trait door, The Alchemist (偏印)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Thinking alone becomes a way to keep unfinished ideas beyond anyone else's reach. At ten at night, you are still tracing an odd link through the notes while a friend's message waits. You leave it there. The private work keeps getting deeper, and harder to share.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · ledger[1] (scene door, The Alchemist (偏印)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: It is Thursday night and Tuesday’s conversation is still running, paused at the one sentence you would take back. You have replayed it enough times to know it will not change, and you replay it anyway, because putting a thought down was never something anyone taught you.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · ledger[2] (outside door, The Alchemist (偏印)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: People can get a careful explanation of your project before they can see a first version. There is another angle to explore, another book that could change the plan. Waiting protects the idea from a rough attempt. It also leaves other people with very little they can use.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · function.advise_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst
value: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.

label: Earth page (your Mind, friction) · cta_verdict · ELEMENT_PAIR.cta_verdict
value: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · mechanism.base · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.base
value: Metal gives Wood a limit. The blade takes a crooked branch at the joint, and the tree keeps the strength that would have gone into it. Growth continues around the cut. A straight piece can become a beam, a crowded crown can open to light, and the edge earns its place by leaving something useful standing.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · carry.wide · ELEMENT_PAIR.carry

value.clause: Wood is already here in plenty, the material the knife is for.
value.remedy: Cut what is already in front of you. Finish it.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · function.definition_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst
value: Wood is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is effort that behaves like a living thing. Whatever you plant and keep tending, money, skills, ventures, trust, grows on its own schedule and pays you back with interest, because your work compounds instead of burning off.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · ledger[0] (trait door, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Improving what you already own comes easier to you than chasing what you don’t, and it shows everywhere you’ve settled. Care, in your hands, behaves like an investment: whatever you maintain appreciates, and whatever needs chasing, you mostly no longer bother to chase.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · ledger[1] (scene door, The Steward (正财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Fifty a month since college. A page a day, a call every Friday, and at no point did any of it look impressive, which is exactly why it worked. Your natural size of effort is small enough to repeat forever, and repetition is where your money and your skill actually come from.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · ledger[2] (outside door, The Horizon (偏财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
note: owner: A, but 'three ventures across two cities' exaggerates; rhetoric in proportion; examples from the persona's ruled domains, not work by default (backlogged)

value.text: People who chase one goal at a time find your calendar hard to explain. You keep three ventures alive across two cities, and somehow the overlaps feed each other instead of colliding. Spreading is simply how opportunity finds enough doors to knock on.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · function.advise_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst
value: You do not need a fresh beginning every time progress gets quiet. Keep a weekly note of what your current work has gained. Give one useful effort a regular place on the calendar. Check the result each month before adding another commitment. Write down the next small task.

label: Wood page (your Action, catalyst, abundant) · cta_verdict · ELEMENT_PAIR.cta_verdict
value: You put effort where it can keep adding value, so work that allows steady improvement can suit you better than a string of fresh starts.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · mechanism.base · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.base
value: Metal meets its own kind in another blade. The same hardness answers back, and contact makes each edge plain against the other. Neither becomes a different material. Laid side by side, the blades keep their separate lines. Pressed together, they put the strength of the same steel against itself.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · mechanism.friction_turn · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.catalyst_turn
value: Run heavy, the blade presses against every edge it meets. Spare force turns small differences into contests. State your objection without trying to win.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · carry.friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.carry
note: owner at Q30: the 'Run heavy,' opener is too upfront; plain prescriptive syntax wanted (backlogged)

value.clause: The blade presses against every edge it meets.
value.remedy: State your objection without trying to win.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · function.definition_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst
value: Metal is your Body, and running over, it is more physical force than your life currently spends: discipline with no outlet, stamina turning into tension you carry in your shoulders and jaw.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · ledger[0] (trait door, The Twin (比肩)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Relying on yourself hardens into refusal when another person offers a hand with work you have already claimed. At six in the evening, the shared document still carries only your edits. You can do the work. Accepting help would mean letting a different standard touch yours, and that is where you draw the line.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · ledger[1] (scene door, The Twin (比肩)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
note: owner: C, but no scene-door version would pass if it keeps the exact time and place detail (at nine in the morning etc.); see backlog item 2

value.text: At ten, an invitation sits beside the schedule you wrote for the evening. You can keep every planned task and still have time for nothing that arrived unplanned. Crossing out a line feels harder than turning down the company, even when the rule has little left to protect.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · ledger[2] (outside door, The Rival (劫财)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
note: owner: B, but the outside door has the same fault as the scene door: far-fetched detail ('by their second week, as onboarding' is filler); explain the trait first; all door versions expand the example instead of illustrating the trait (backlog item 2 widened to all three doors)

value.text: People collaborate with you in armor now: terms written, credit pre-assigned, nothing left ambiguous. The precautions slow everything and offend you slightly. But the stories that mandated them are specific, dated, and told to every newcomer by their second week, as onboarding.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · function.advise_friction · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst
value: You can mistake the ability to keep pushing for a reason to continue. Give each task a stopping point before you begin. Leave a short break between commitments without filling it. In a disagreement, hear the other answer through. Let your next reply wait a breath.

label: Metal page (your Body, the core, friction) · cta_verdict · ELEMENT_PAIR.cta_verdict
value: You bend for nothing and call it strength, and your body keeps that bargain until the day it presents the bill.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · mechanism.base · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.base
value: In the old reckoning water is metal's child: cold iron beads the morning dew, and metal, melted, runs bright as any river. The hard thing does not stay hard. At its finest edge it turns liquid, and what was fixed begins to flow, the clear stream carrying the mountain's sharpness out into the world.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · mechanism.catalyst_turn · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.catalyst_turn
value: Run thin, this channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said. That is why your chart asks you to feed it. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · carry.catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.carry
note: split pick: B's clause, C's remedy (writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe)

value.clause: Water gathers on the blade but hardly leaves its edge.
value.remedy: Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · function.definition_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst
value: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is the part of your effort that reaches another person. A thought becomes a sentence someone can follow, or care becomes a meal you share. What you make gives your attention somewhere beyond yourself to go.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · ledger[0] (trait door, The Artisan (食神)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Expression comes to you the way walking comes to other people, without assembly or rehearsal. What costs everyone else three drafts costs you a breath, and the ease is invisible from inside. You do not know where the words are before they arrive. They just do.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · ledger[1] (scene door, The Artisan (食神)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
from: original (no pick: all three rejected; held as the original pending backlog item 2)
note: No scene passed: too specific on details, reader loses track of the conclusion (backlog item 2, all three doors)

value.text: They arrive wound tight, sit down at your kitchen table, and something loosens over the second hour. Soup helps, and so does the way you ask questions. By the door they are lighter and cannot name what happened. You can. It happens every time.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · ledger[2] (outside door, The Virtuoso (伤官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Listeners can follow your wording past a point they first argued against. You find a different way through the objection, with a turn of phrase that keeps the exchange moving. That skill can help a difficult conversation, though agreement reached smoothly still needs something solid behind it.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · function.advise_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst
value: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it to done, not to pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Comfort that never risks anything eventually feeds no one.

label: Water page (your Expression, catalyst, thin) · cta_verdict · ELEMENT_PAIR.cta_verdict
value: You express yourself through things others can use, so an ordinary conversation can become easier once you give your thought a clear form.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · mechanism.base · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.base
value: The refined prevails over the stubborn: fire alone commands metal. In the forge the unbending learns to bend, ore gives up its rock, and the blade takes whatever shape the flame decides. Heat is the one argument metal cannot win, and what survives the fire comes out finer than what went in.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · mechanism.catalyst_turn · ELEMENT_PAIR.mechanism.catalyst_turn
from: split: first sentence blind, the rest original (owner: "B the first sentence, C the second sentence"; the directive kept with the second pile so the carry cut at Q48 matches)
note: split pick: B's first sentence (the forge lacks the heat to reshape the steel), C's second sentence (an edge that keeps its first shape and calls it character)
value: Run thin, the forge lacks the heat to reshape the steel. Your chart asks for heat. Take the demanding role, the audit, the arena.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · carry.catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.carry
note: split pick: B's clause (the forge lacks the heat to reshape the steel), A's remedy (take the demanding role, the audit, the arena)

value.clause: The forge lacks the heat to reshape the steel.
value.remedy: Take the demanding role, the audit, the arena.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · function.definition_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.definition_catalyst
value: Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is a demand that gives your strength a useful shape. A deadline makes a choice necessary, and a clear standard gives effort something to answer to. You know what is required. Pressure can gather your force around the task that matters.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · ledger[0] (trait door, The General (七杀)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

value.text: Pressure makes the next necessary choice plain to you. When a plan breaks down, you can name what must happen before the rest can matter. The list gets shorter. Your attention gathers around the task at hand, though a clear choice still leaves you responsible for its cost.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · ledger[1] (scene door, The General (七杀)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
note: relative pick only: A is good relatively, but the scene fails again (too much narrating and descriptive detail); backlog item 2

value.text: The call everyone dreaded sat on your list for exactly one day. You made it standing up, between two other tasks, and it went the way these things usually go with you, which is fine. Three weeks of collective dread died in four unremarkable minutes.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · ledger[2] (outside door, The General (七杀)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading
note: with reservation: an outside door opening with how people react to you is not better than describing how the user reacts to a crisis themselves; the outside-door lens is not the best lens here (new backlog item 5)

value.text: People can use your instructions when the plan they were following breaks down. You pick out what needs attention and give the next task a clear shape. That focus is useful under pressure, though the same force can press too hard on others once the urgent part is over.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · function.advise_catalyst · ELEMENT_PAIR.function.advise_catalyst
value: Fire that only knows battle starts inventing battles. Save your command for what deserves it: decide the small stuff instantly and cheaply. Build one boring routine that runs when nothing is burning. Peacetime is what the fighting was for, so practice standing in it.

label: Fire page (your Order, catalyst, thin) · cta_verdict · ELEMENT_PAIR.cta_verdict
value: Pressure is your forge, and the heat you choose on purpose finishes an edge that comfort would have left dull.
